lower_bound.reason: More than one separately charged admission/type/expression step is required before any complete source result, even with empty operands.

adequate_cases.name: maximum-256
adequate_cases.basis: 512 input Int leaves, 256 canonical key-set checks, 256 simple additions with bounded bindings, 256 detached output leaves and one final collection. No recursive numerical proof, tessellation or data-dependent looping. Ordinary 100000 operations is a conservative finite-fixture allowance, not an exact charge count.

adequate_cases.name: panel-task-higher-budget
adequate_cases.basis: Two paired keys in each of two occurrences, four 12-triangle panels plus one 12-triangle marker, one 89-byte PNG, and five fixed poses over one second. Fourfold ordinary authority is explicitly requested and independently host-authorized before candidate execution; no measured candidate cost sets this bound.
